data.standardized_narrative: At the start of 2014 gross claims outstanding were GBP 1,537.0m. During the year there was a net release in prior-year claims reserves of GBP 8.2m (reported net of reinsurance), reducing prior year reserves slightly (0.53% of opening reserves). The reduction in the magnitude of prior-year releases relative to 2013 was driven in part by adverse development on New Zealand earthquake claims (c. GBP 8.5m adverse), while 2014 also experienced several large current-year catastrophe and major loss events (Nebraska tornados, aviation hull losses, UK storms) that impacted the year's claims experience.
raw_causal_phrases: releases from reserves established in prior years of GBP 8.2 million (2013: GBP 52.4 million).
There has also been a reduction in prior year reserve releases, in particular impacted by deterioration on the New Zealand earthquake claims amounting to GBP 8.5 million for the year.
The movement in the net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 8.2 million (2013: GBP 52.4 million) in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet liabilities (Claims outstanding) prior-year column. The report does not provide a GROSS (insurance liabilities) movement in prior-year claims; only a NET prior-year release (GBP 8.2m) is explicitly stated and so the prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the NET figure (flagged here). Several narrative figures for losses (e.g. Nebraska tornados GBP 26.7m, NZ earthquake GBP 8.5m) are presented but the report often does not state whether these amounts are gross or net; where the report states 'losses experienced' these have been treated as net to the syndicate as presented. No gross claims development triangle was found in the document.
